gloss: limited express ticket; express surcharge ticket

definitions.gloss: limited express ticket; express surcharge ticket
definitions.explanation: A supplementary ticket required in addition to a base fare ticket to ride a limited express (特急) train in Japan. Composed of 特急 (limited express) + 券 (ticket). Without this ticket, passengers cannot ride reserved or non-reserved cars on limited express services.

examples.japanese: {特急券|とっきゅうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}い→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I forgot to buy the express ticket.

examples.japanese: ⟦{乗車券|じょうしゃけん}→乗車券：05298_joushaken⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{特急券|とっきゅうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧{五千円|ごせんえん}だった。
examples.english: The base ticket and the express ticket together came to 5,000 yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{乗車券|じょうしゃけん}→乗車券：05298_joushaken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{他|ほか}→他：04129_hoka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{特急券|とっきゅうけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: To ride the bullet train, you need an express ticket in addition to a base fare ticket.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japan's railway system, faster train services require a {特急券|とっきゅうけん} on top of the regular ⟦{乗車券|じょうしゃけん}→乗車券：05298_joushaken⟧ (base fare ticket). This includes the ⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧ (bullet train) and other limited express services run by JR and private railways.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {特急券|とっきゅうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (buy an express ticket)
- ⟦{指定席|していせき}→指定席：07046_shiteiseki⟧{特急券|とっきゅうけん} (reserved-seat express ticket)
- ⟦{自由席|じゆうせき}→自由席：07047_jiyuuseki⟧{特急券|とっきゅうけん} (non-reserved express ticket)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{乗車券|じょうしゃけん}→乗車券：05298_joushaken⟧ (base fare ticket)
- ⟦{指定席券|していせきけん}→指定席券：17902_shiteisekiken⟧ (reserved seat ticket)
- ⟦{回数券|かいすうけん}→回数券：08451_kaisuuken⟧ (multi-ride ticket)
- ⟦{定期券|ていきけん}→定期券：01064_teikiken⟧ (commuter pass)
